records.context: Original Shared Commands/Info/Ship Data Help and source-linked neighbors; current labels and reviewed role terminology retained.
records.source_meaning: Item descriptions/equipping; list selection opens item screen. Source square action equips/uses according to item type. Wearer name is red when equipped item is unrelated to job; reassign item or job.
records.localization_note: The name, not the item, turns red. Describe the equip/use action without carrying over an unsupported source-platform square glyph.

水夫編成（共通コマンド）
水夫を船に配置します。
水夫の「必要数／現在数／最大数」が各船に表示されます。十字ボタンの左右で船ごとに現在数を増減します。自動で一括編成することもできます。
必要数より水夫が少ないと船が遅くなります。
［旗艦重視］旗艦へ優先的に配置。
［平均化］最大数に対する割合を均等に配置。［必要最小］必要数のみを配置。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Assign Sailors
records.english: Distribute sailors among your ships. Each ship shows Need, Now and Max: required, current and maximum crew. Press Left or Right to adjust a ship's current crew, or choose Auto to assign all ships at once. Ships below Need sail more slowly. Auto offers three policies: give priority to the flagship; assign the same percentage of maximum crew to each ship; or assign only the required minimum.
records.context: Original Shared Commands/Info/Ship Data Help and source-linked neighbors; current labels and reviewed role terminology retained.
records.source_meaning: Crew assignment; required/current/max counts; left/right adjust each ship; bulk auto supported. Below requirement slows ship. Flagship priority, equal maximum-relative percentages, required-minimum policies.
records.localization_note: Explain all three policies accurately without manual rows or ambiguous fill-first shorthand.

現在耐久力が最大耐久力より低いときは、造船所で修理すると戻ります。

records.heading: Hull

records.context: Original Shared Commands/Info/Ship Data Help and source-linked neighbors; current labels and reviewed role terminology retained.
records.source_meaning: Current/max durability; equality means no damage; lower current is restored by shipyard repair.
records.localization_note: Match the existing Hull field and retain the undamaged condition.

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Water and Food
records.english: These are the barrels of water and food remaining. Running out causes crew fatigue to rise sharply. Your food lasts longer with help from [[116|Animal Keepers]] and [[115|Chief Cooks]].

records.localization_note: State the net food benefit without changing the Keeper's food production into a consumption formula.

「主横帆性能＋副横帆性能」です。高いほど、順風での航海速度が上がります。
主横帆性能は、メインマストの[[52|帆種]]と装備によります。副横帆性能は、フォアマスト（メインマストの前方のマスト）とミズンマスト（メインマストの後方のマスト）によります。フォアマスト・ミズンマストは、船種によってないことがあります。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Square Sail Performance
records.english: This is main plus auxiliary square-sail performance. Higher values let you sail faster with the wind behind you. Main performance depends on the mainmast's [[52|sail type]] and equipment. Auxiliary performance comes from the foremast ahead of the mainmast and the mizzenmast behind it. Some ship types lack these auxiliary masts.
records.context: Original Shared Commands/Info/Ship Data Help and source-linked neighbors; current labels and reviewed role terminology retained.
records.source_meaning: Main+secondary horizontal sail values improve following-wind speed. Mainmast sail type/equipment determine main; fore/mizzen masts determine secondary; ship type may lack these.
records.localization_note: Keep both mast positions, main/auxiliary distinction and possible absence; do not promise arbitrary faster sailing.
